QUOTE: By default, `ssl->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ssl->private_state`, so code that touches a field directly fails to compile. The struct layout and the ABI are identical either way. The guard only changes the spelling the compiler sees.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the opacity is enforced at compile time by renaming the member (`private_` prefix) while the layout stays identical, so the fields remain visible and sized.
